olivia-cs: Heads-up: VelaTech renewal 94 procurement needs invoice to VelaTech UK Ltd but payment coming from VelaTech NA (US card). They want invoice today to attach to PO. Risk: tax/VAT mismatch. Can legal/finance advise? :warning:
tariq-am: Are we keeping 12mo? Any concession asks?
olivia-cs: Yes 12mo. They requested a 2% "processing" credit if we accept mixed-entity payor and net45. PO: VT-PO-4421. Signer: "Nora P., Finance Director".
hannah-legal: We can accept if they provide VAT reg or sign a remit addendum with indemnity. DocuSign OK. Need PO text and signer title.
kevin-fin: Ops: we prefer wire to UK account. If CC from US, require vendor code + payor auth form. If they want CC fallback, define clear window (e.g., 7 days). Also confirm currency (GBP).
olivia-cs: Sent PO snippet and vendor code VT-VC-88. DocuSign envelope: https://docusign.com/envelope/VELA-4499 (sent). Asked them to confirm wire vs CC fallback.
docusign-bot: DocuSign VELA-4499 status: sent (1 pending). View: https://docusign.com/envelope/VELA-4499
hannah-legal: Hold final invoice until either VAT reg received or addendum signed. If they sign without VAT, we'll include indemnity clause. If they still push on 2% credit, pricing will review.
tariq-am: I'll track the 2% credit request; don't commit yet. Thx team.
olivia-cs: Customer replied: will try wire today, fallback to CC after 7 days. They will sign addendum. I'll update once signed. :thumbsup:
